retracts: Finding 1 as stated in results/two_task_summary.json, results/matched_final_mortality.json and results/FINAL_SUMMARY.json
claim_retracted: A TF-IDF floor is never worse than a 110M domain-pretrained transformer, and the gap tracks the floor.
why: The floor was evaluated on FULL note text while the neural arms were capped at chars_per_note AND a per-segment token cap of (max_len-2)//8 = 63 tokens AND the total sequence budget. Measured: floor read 6,587 chars/bundle, neural arms encoded 1,545. A 4.3x asymmetry.
conclusion: At genuinely matched input the floor advantage vanishes on mortality (+0.002) and REVERSES on readmission (-0.018). PubMedBERT beats the floor on readmission. The claim is false as stated.
aggravating: results/floor_matched_budget.json already documented this exact defect and the final harness reverted to full text anyway. The 0.8673 figure in the summary tables appears in no run log; it was computed outside the harness and paired with a CI from a different configuration.
fix: scripts/run_matched.py now routes the floor through neural_window_rows(), applying all three caps in the same order as the neural datasets.
what_survives: The proxy-metric decoupling: a 1.32 +/- 0.015 nat MLM gap across 7 arms x 3 seeds transfers to at most ~0.03 AUROC downstream. And the provenance falsification, which is independent of this bug.
